name: Katsunuma (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Katsunuma town emblem in white: a stylised bunch of grapes in a shield-like shape, with the characters 勝沼町 below.
history: Flag of the former town of Katsunuma in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-11-01.
